description: An agent-authored summary and thread replies whose external authority is checked against one reopened pull-request observation.

go_only_rules.rule: Generic validation checks only deterministic response shape. Before an external effect, the platform reopens the primary pull-request/v1 subject and verifies the named batch and every reply thread are authorized by that exact batch.
Batch and thread identifiers are at most 256 bytes and a response contains at most 512 replies.
